rows.label: clavicle
rows.description: plain bone of short length that serves as a strut between the scapula and the sternum
rows.hook: is the only long bone in the body that lies sideways, named for a Latin word for a little key

rows.label: coccyx
rows.hook: is the leftover of a tail from our distant ancestors, nicknamed the tailbone

rows.label: sternum
rows.description: flat bone in the middle front part of the rib cage
rows.hook: is the necktie-shaped breastbone that helps protect the heart and lungs

rows.label: scapula
rows.description: bone that connects the humerus (upper arm bone) with the clavicle (collar bone)
rows.hook: is named for a small shovel it was thought to resemble

rows.label: fibula
rows.description: leg bone next to the tibia
rows.hook: is the slender calf bone, thinnest of the long bones for its length

rows.label: pelvis
rows.description: lower part of the trunk of the human body between the abdomen and the thighs (sometimes also called pelvic region of the trunk
rows.hook: is the basin-shaped ring of hip bones that a baby passes through at birth

rows.label: femur
rows.hook: is the thigh bone, the largest and thickest bone in the human body

rows.label: tibia
rows.description: long bone of the lower leg
rows.hook: is the shinbone, the larger of the two bones below the knee

rows.label: vertebra
rows.hook: is one of the stacked bones that make up the backbone

rows.label: sacrum
rows.description: triangular-shaped bone at the bottom of the spine
rows.hook: is a triangular bone formed by five fused vertebrae at the base of the backbone

rows.label: skull
rows.description: bony or cartilaginous structure that forms the skeleton of head in vertebrates
rows.hook: is the bony enclosure that protects the brain

rows.label: hyoid bone
rows.description: horseshoe-shaped bone situated in the anterior midline of the neck between the chin and the thyroid cartilage
